Modifies and formats parameter estimates in a dataframe

modify_parameter_estimates.Rd

Rounds numeric columns to specified precision and creates formatted p-value strings. Non-numeric columns are left unchanged. A new column 'pvalue_str' is added containing formatted p-values.

Usage

modify_parameter_estimates(df, round_digits = 3, add_equal_sign = T)

Arguments

df

A dataframe containing parameter estimates, including at least a `pvalue` column for formatting

round_digits

Number of decimal places to round numeric values to (default: 3)

add_equal_sign

Logical; whether to prepend "=" to p-value strings (default: TRUE)
